headline: Hopes for a Hormuz agreement fade after Trump's new demands on Iran
summary: Hopes for a Hormuz agreement have faded after US President Donald Trump responded to Iran's conditions for a peace deal with his own demands.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil and LNG trade. Diplomacy over the strait feeds directly into energy prices and shipping insurance.
why_moved: Trump's new demands on Iran reduced hopes for a Hormuz agreement, raising the risk of disruption to Gulf oil transit.

original_headline: Se desvanecen las esperanzas de un acuerdo en Ormuz tras las nuevas demandas de Trump a Irán
